questions.q:
In a database table, explain what is meant by:
(a) a field [1]
(b) a record. [1]
ms: (a) a single item of data / attribute about each item, i.e. a column in the table (e.g. Surname)
(b) all the data about one item / person / thing, i.e. a row in the table
questions.model:
(a) A field is one category of data stored about every item, shown as a column, such as Price.
(b) A record is the complete set of data about one item, shown as a row.

S01    | Pace    | Trainer | 7    | 45.00 | TRUE
S02    | Nordo   | Boot    | 9    | 80.00 | FALSE

Write an SQL query to display the ShoeID, Brand and Price of all boots that are in stock, in ascending order of Price.
ms: ORDER BY Price ASC (allow ORDER BY Price) (1)
questions.model:
SELECT ShoeID, Brand, Price
FROM Shoe
WHERE Style = "Boot" AND InStock = TRUE
ORDER BY Price ASC;

questions.q:
Table: Shoe
ShoeID | Brand   | Style   | Size | Price | InStock
S01    | Pace    | Trainer | 7    | 45.00 | TRUE
S02    | Nordo   | Boot    | 9    | 80.00 | FALSE
S03    | Pace    | Sandal  | 6    | 25.50 | TRUE
S04    | Kestrel | Trainer | 9    | 60.00 | TRUE
S05    | Nordo   | Trainer | 8    | 55.00 | TRUE
S06    | Kestrel | Boot    | 7    | 95.00 | FALSE
S07    | Pace    | Boot    | 8    | 70.00 | TRUE
(a) Write an SQL query to calculate the total price of all the Pace shoes. [3]
(b) State the result of your query in (a). [1]
(c) State the output of:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Shoe WHERE InStock = FALSE OR Size < 7; [1]
questions.model:
(a) SELECT SUM(Price)
FROM Shoe
WHERE Brand = "Pace";
(b) 45.00 + 25.50 + 70.00 = 140.50
(c) S02 and S06 are not in stock, and S03 has size 6, so the output is 3.
questions.tip: SUM adds up a numeric field; COUNT(*) counts records.

questions.q:
Table: Shoe
ShoeID | Brand   | Style   | Size | Price | InStock
S01    | Pace    | Trainer | 7    | 45.00 | TRUE
S02    | Nordo   | Boot    | 9    | 80.00 | FALSE
S03    | Pace    | Sandal  | 6    | 25.50 | TRUE
S04    | Kestrel | Trainer | 9    | 60.00 | TRUE
S05    | Nordo   | Trainer | 8    | 55.00 | TRUE
S06    | Kestrel | Boot    | 7    | 95.00 | FALSE
S07    | Pace    | Boot    | 8    | 70.00 | TRUE
This query should display the Brand and Size of all trainers that cost more than 50, in alphabetical order of Brand. It contains three errors.
SELECT Brand Size
FROM Shoes
WHERE Style = "Trainer" AND Price > 50
ORDER BY Brand DESC;
(a) Identify and correct the three errors. [3]
(b) State the output of the corrected query. [3]
ms: (a) wrong order: ORDER BY Brand ASC (1)
(b) Kestrel before Nordo and no other records / fields (1)
questions.model:
(a) SELECT Brand Size should be SELECT Brand, Size. FROM Shoes should be FROM Shoe. ORDER BY Brand DESC should be ORDER BY Brand ASC.
(b)
Kestrel   9
Nordo     8
questions.tip: Alphabetical order = ASC; DESC is Z to A.
